title: CMES Robotics Brings AI-Powered Mixed Case Palletizer to the U.S. for the First Time at PACK EXPO International 2026
summary: CMES Robotics is bringing its AI-vision mixed-case palletizing system to the U.S. for the first time at PACK EXPO International 2026, after an international debut earlier that year. The system targets distribution centers and 3PL operations where varied case handling creates labor, throughput, and safety pressure, using AI vision to automate palletizing in less uniform, higher-friction warehouse environments.

extra.full_text: Following its international debut in Q1 2026, the AI-vision palletizing system makes its U.S. debut, addressing labor shortages, throughput bottlenecks, and safety risks in distribution centers and 3PLs.

title: European TALOS project demonstrates autonomous robots for solar plant maintenance
summary: The European TALOS project has wrapped three years of Horizon Europe-backed trials of autonomous robots and AI for solar plant maintenance, with demonstrations at sites in Spain, Portugal, and the Netherlands. The system monitors solar farms, detects performance problems, evaluates which maintenance tasks are economically worthwhile, and recommends interventions, pointing toward more automated, cost-aware operations for large photovoltaic sites.
